description: Creates a permanent page /p/<slug> with a printable QR: a fixed price, a customer-entered amount (optionally with min/max), or 2–6 top-up packs shown as buttons (e.g. 1 000 / 5 000 / 10 000 KZT). Every payment becomes an ordinary invoice (webhooks fire as usual; metadata.paymentLinkId). For balance top-ups give packs and send each user to url + "?ref=<userId>" — the ref lands in the invoice metadata. Packs and a fixed amount are mutually exclusive. Needs links:manage or invoices:write; the tariff caps how many links exist.

amount.description: Fixed price in KZT; omit to let the customer type the amount

collect.description: Fields the customer must fill in before paying

maxAmount.description: Upper limit for a customer-entered amount

minAmount.description: Lower limit for a customer-entered amount

slug.description: URL part, 3–40 chars a-z 0-9 and -; random if omitted; cannot be changed later

successUrl.description: Where the customer returns after paying

title.description: Shown on the page, e.g. "Coffee" or "Balance top-up"

name: qutpay_create_payment_link
title: Create a payment link (permanent pay page + QR)
